summary: 晚上 ACDC #184 收集 Hegotá 非头条提案，Barnabé Monnot 提出把 slot 从 12 秒降到 10 秒的 quick slots，另有 VOPS、block in blobs、RowDAS、发行销毁等陈述。账户与 gas 方面，EIP-8141 PR 补上 frame 交易的初始 warm 地址集合，EIP-8297 把 EIP-7702 委托标识存进账户头并合并，rakita 发起 EIP-8358 账户变更净 gas 计量讨论。

items.topic: 账户与交易的 gas 细节
items.title: EIP-8141：固定 frame 交易的初始 accessed_addresses 集合
items.note: （Marchhill）提交。规范没写 frame 交易处理时的初始 warm 集合，导致首次访问 `tx.sender` 时 `gas_used` 可能分歧（有客户端按 COLD 收费，EIP-2929/3651 则视为 warm）；PR 把集合定为 EIP-2929/EIP-3651 集合（`tx.sender`、coinbase、预编译）减去任何 frame 目标。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: pin the initial accessed_addresses set for frame transactions
items.note_en: (Marchhill), submitted. The spec did not define the initial warm set for frame transaction processing, so `gas_used` could diverge at the first `tx.sender` access (some clients charge it COLD, while EIP-2929/3651 warm it); the PR pins the set to the EIP-2929/EIP-3651 set (`tx.sender`, coinbase, precompiles) minus any frame target.

items.title: EIP-8297：把委托标识存进账户头
items.note: （CPerezz）合并，配套的 EIP-8347 PR 同日合并。原设计中 EIP-7702 委托标识是 `CODE_ZONE` 里按内容寻址的代码块，委托同一目标的账户共享一个叶子；清除或替换委托时，客户端必须判断全状态里是否还有账户委托该目标，这无法在区块局部回答。
items.title_en: EIP-8297: store delegation indicators in the account header
items.note_en: (CPerezz), merged, with the companion EIP-8347 PR merged the same day. Previously EIP-7702 delegation indicators were content-addressed code chunks in `CODE_ZONE`, so every account delegating to the same target shared one leaf; clearing or replacing a delegation forced a client to determine whether any account anywhere still delegated to that target, which cannot be answered block-locally.

items.title: Magicians：EIP-8358 账户变更的净 gas 计量
items.note: 04:40（rakita）。仿照 EIP-2200 的存储方案，账户在余额或 nonce 与交易开始时不同时才算变更，CALL 和 CALLCODE 的转账成本据此调整。
items.title_en: Magicians: EIP-8358 net gas metering for account changes
items.note_en: 04:40 (rakita). Mirroring the EIP-2200 scheme for storage, an account counts as changed only once its balance or nonce differs from its value at the start of the transaction, and the value transfer cost of CALL and CALLCODE follows from that.

summary_en: In the evening ACDC #184 collected Hegotá non-headliner proposals: Barnabé Monnot pitched quick slots, cutting slots from 12 to 10 seconds, alongside presentations on VOPS, block in blobs, RowDAS and the issuance burn. On account and gas details, an EIP-8141 PR fills in the initial warm address set for frame transactions, EIP-8297 now stores EIP-7702 delegation indicators in the account header (merged), and rakita opened discussion of EIP-8358 net gas metering for account changes.
